mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 72 degrees, though the air quality index is elevated at 52. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City officials are moving forward with phase two of the Aldi development road work on Highway M, which will shift traffic patterns starting the week of September 7. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail will see closures from mid-September to mid-November to facilitate a bridge replacement project near Lincoln Street.

There is a busy schedule ahead. Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, the Verona Downtown Farmers Market is on September 9, and you can enjoy trivia at various spots like Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee early next week.

The Verona Police Department is investigating a case involving the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member. The incident was reported on Sunday, August 30, and has resulted in the arrest of a Madison resident.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
